IS : 10370 ( Part II ) - 1982 

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS OF 

MOUNTING ACCESSORIES OF 

POT CORES FOR WIRED CIRCUITS 

PART II FOR POT CORES OF SIZE 18 x II mm 
0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard (Part II) was adopted by the Indian 
Standards Institution on 30 November 1982, after the draft finalized by 
the Magnetic Components and Ferrite Material Sectional Committee had 
been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division 
Council. 

0,2 The object of this standard is to specify the dimensions of mounting 
accessories of pot-cores made o^ ferromagnetic oxides. 

0,3 This standard is intended to be one of the series of Indian Standards 
on dimensions of mounting accessories of pot-cores of various sizes for 
wired circuits. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard ( Part II ) covers following mounting accessories to 
be used with pot cores for wired circuits and of size 18 X 11 mm ( see 
IS: 6235-19711): 

a) Bobbins, 

b) Clamp for pot core, and 

c) Disc for pot core clamp. 



♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 

fDimensions of pot cores made of ferromagnetic oxides and associated parts.

2,2.1 The material used for clamp shall be half hard brass, of alloy
